messages.subject: D-RUG tomorrow: Model selection
parts:
Hi all,

At D-RUG tomorrow, Rosemary Hartman will be presenting a case study of model selection of GLMs and GAMs for determining predictors of frog habitat.  She will also go over some tricks for plotting terms of GLMs and model averaging. 

As per usual, we'll meet at 3-5PM in 2124 Wickson. Rosemary will present for the first ~30 minutes, and the rest of the time will be our open work and Q&A session.

Noam
